name: Leverage Strategy Toolkit
focus: Provide customers with the data, technical indicators, strategy building blocks, testing and risk tools needed to create and evaluate their own trading strategies.
progress_basis: Execution progress of the reusable customer toolkit, not trading profitability and not selection of a winning strategy.
selection_policy: Customer chooses the instrument, indicators, strategy template, parameters, rules and final strategy. Leverage provides evidence and tools but does not silently select or market a strategy as the best.
current_phase: Customer toolkit architecture defined; BTCUSDT data gate passed with 500 validated rows
next_phase: Build customer-facing indicator lab, strategy builder and reusable backtest workspace
data_policy: RM0 research stack; permitted public/export access only; preserve raw files; no scraping bypass; no paid real-time feed dependency
customer_flow: Customer decides whether to use it
benchmark_role: The benchmark engine is a reusable testing tool and example implementation. It must not be presented as an automated winner-selection engine.
cross_market_role: Customers can compare their own strategy configurations across BTCUSDT, XAUUSDT, CL and FCPO using the same research standards where instrument semantics allow.
dataset_status: BTCUSDT: 500 daily rows acquired, canonical OHLCV validation passed, and artifact preserved. XAUUSDT/CL source validation and FCPO RM0 research remain active.
current_work: Strategy page converted from winner scoreboard to customer workspace
Reusable backtest benchmark retained as a tool rather than a selector
Next: implement Indicator Lab and Strategy Builder
XAUUSDT and CL source validation follow
FCPO remains parallel and does not block the toolkit
boss_action_required: No payment required. No manual action required for BTCUSDT data. Customer control is the product principle.
latest_result: Product scope corrected: Leverage will provide the tools and evidence customers need to find their own strategy. It will not automatically choose the best strategy for them.
